# Agent governance kit

> Governance framework for AI agents: autonomy levels L0-L4, risk classes R0-R4, approval tiers, kill switches, audit spine, promotion gate; mapped to OWASP, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001; healthcare overlay for India; Python policy checker.

Sanitised public showcase by Dr. Ravi Teja Thiriveedhi (clinician turned AI systems architect). Scope and limits: [TRUST.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/agent-governance-kit/blob/main/TRUST.md).

## Docs

- [docs/autonomy-levels.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/agent-governance-kit/blob/main/docs/autonomy-levels.md): L0 Observer to L4 Autonomous
- [docs/risk-classes.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/agent-governance-kit/blob/main/docs/risk-classes.md): R0 read to R4 external, money, clinical, deletion, secrets
- [docs/controls.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/agent-governance-kit/blob/main/docs/controls.md): HITL tiers, kill switches, audit spine, exec gate, injection defence
- [docs/standards-mapping.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/agent-governance-kit/blob/main/docs/standards-mapping.md): OWASP, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, DPDP
- [docs/healthcare-overlay.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/agent-governance-kit/blob/main/docs/healthcare-overlay.md): Clinic and hospital rules for India
- [kit/govcheck.py](https://github.com/sterilefield/agent-governance-kit/blob/main/kit/govcheck.py): Policy and audit checker
